sections.name: architecture
sections.value: DELTA on a live mechanism, not a build. InteractionGate (crates/harnesses/src/interaction.rs) stays the single decision point; PaneObserver stays the cadence feeder; the three consumers (delivery first-attempt, drain retries, pointer worker) stay consumers. Two additions: (1) the gate's verdict gains TIME (idle expiry) and SELF-KNOWLEDGE (echo exemption); (2) a second entry point, permits_injection_fresh, takes one fresh capture at the send boundary instead of trusting the last observer tick. Composer-region parsing becomes a PURE function in pij-harnesses so both the observer and the fresh path share one parser. The TS reference is .pi/extensions/pij/core/daemon/pane-signals.ts with its operator contract at core/daemon/typing-guard-contract.test.ts — port the CONTRACT, not the code. Named non-goal from history: TS's port-level universal weld was emergency-bypassed fleet-wide for over-hold (72b5dd61); idle expiry is the anti-over-hold mitigation and its witness must be seen RED first. AMENDED AT THE PM ACK (4 objections accepted, docs/plans/111-anti-step-on/assets/pm-ack.md): the seam carries cursor coordinates; u-observer is an extraction; PendingClear is preserved by name; the fresh path never drains the tap. AMENDMENT 2 (PM escalation, 2026-08-31): ONE LAW BOUNDS EVERY VETO — a veto is only as good as the observation it cites, and no veto may cite an observation older than interaction_idle_ms. Recognized-idle already decays (that IS idle expiry); Unrecognized and the tap latch now decay the same way: absent a fresh positive interaction observation, the verdict degrades to TmuxPort::user_typing (pane_in_mode) alone — today's pre-plan behaviour, never a permanent hold. Deferral stays the FIRST response to Unrecognized; the bound is what keeps 'conservative' from meaning 'forever'.

value.decision: Two units, both wave 1, parallel against one frozen seam.
value.rationale: The seam is one pure function signature plus three gate methods — small enough to freeze on day one. u-gate is pure state machine (no I/O, clock injected); u-observer is parsing + wiring. Neither reads the other's unfinished code; the contract test at the seam proves the handshake before composition.

value.name: gate semantics: idle expiry, self-echo exemption, fresh-boundary entry point
value.depends_on: nothing — builds against the frozen seam signature below
value.responsibility: (1) observe_composer stamps a change-time; an unchanged non-blank composer older than the idle window (default 60_000ms, injectable clock + constructor override for tests) no longer vetoes — a parked draft delays, never blocks. (2) record_self_injection(pane, payload): a subsequent composer observation that is pij's own payload (exact whitespace-collapsed match, TS rule) never ACQUIRES a hold; NO echo ever CLEARS an active human hold. (3) permits_injection_fresh(pane): one capture + cursor read via TmuxPort at call time, parsed with the frozen composer_region fn, feeds the observation, ANDs with tick-derived tap state (never drains the tap), then answers. Unrecognized DEFERS. Honest cost note: cursors come from list_panes(), which is fleet-wide — two tmux round-trips per gated send; acceptable, but say so in the findings doc, and cache/scope only if measurement forces it. AMENDMENT 2: implement the universal veto bound (ac-1117) — the gate tracks the age of the newest interaction observation per pane (content change, tap byte, unknown-classification counts as an observation of UNCERTAINTY not of interaction); when every veto-supporting observation is older than the idle window, permits_injection/permits_injection_fresh fall back to the tmux mode flag alone. Red-first: prove an Unrecognized pane is vetoed forever on the pre-amendment tree.
value.interface: FROZEN v2 (amended at PM ack) — pub fn composer_region(capture: &str, cursor_x: u32, cursor_y: u32) -> ComposerRegion; pub enum ComposerRegion { Recognized(String), Unrecognized } (lives in pij-harnesses; u-observer extracts the live parser into it, u-gate consumes). No harness parameter — recognition is layout-derived, exactly as the live parser does it. Gate additions: pub fn record_self_injection(&self, pane: &str, payload: &str); pub async fn permits_injection_fresh(&self, pane: &str) -> Result<bool> — fresh means the COMPOSER half only: capture+cursors+parse at call time, ANDed with the TICK-DERIVED tap state; it never drains the pane tap (the drain is destructive and owned by the observer loop). The tap-staleness limit is recorded in the findings doc rather than over-claimed away. Constructor gains idle window + clock injection without breaking existing new() callers.
value.test_strategy: Pure unit tests, clock injected, no tmux. RED-FIRST: the parked-draft witness (ac-1111) must FAIL on the pre-fix tree — run it there and paste the red into the receipt. Port the TS contract cases by NAME from typing-guard-contract.test.ts (parked draft ≤60s then sends; typing-through-restart not re-baselined; self-echo never acquires and never destroys; whitespace-insensitive emptiness). Mutation proof: revert idle expiry -> witness fails; loosen echo match to substring -> paste-eaten test fails.
value.note: Do NOT invent a caret/byte-density tracker; tap-active veto stays as-is. Keep it small.

value.name: EXTRACT the live composer parser + explicit Unrecognized + rewire
value.depends_on: nothing — implements the frozen composer_region signature
value.paths: a new parsing module in crates/harnesses (e.g. src/composer.rs) + crates/daemon/src/pane_observer.rs + crates/testkit fakes as needed; crates/tmux only if capture needs a flag
value.responsibility: EXTRACTION, not a build — the parser already lives at crates/daemon/src/pane_observer.rs:389-513 (rendered_composer + clip_payload/clip_multiline/strip_prompt/is_plain_rule/is_copilot_footer, ~130 lines) and handles OMP box row, plain-rule pairs with box-drawing excluded, copilot footer, caret clip, prompt strip. Move it into pij-harnesses behind composer_region(capture, cursor_x, cursor_y) -> ComposerRegion, making today's silent None an explicit Unrecognized. Rewire PaneObserver through the extracted fn. PRESERVE PendingClear BY NAME (pane_observer.rs:20-28, 258-282): blank capture + tap_active + prior observation stays a veto — a redraw yields a blank capture with stale cursor coords, and that anti-race guard turns no AC red if deleted, so it is protected by instruction, characterisation tests, and review priority, not by hoping. The TS parser (.pi/extensions/pij/core/daemon/pane-signals.ts:76-227) is the CROSS-CHECK for edge cases, never a second implementation — one artifact, one formatter. AMENDMENT 2: rebuild Copilot recognition from the LIVE v1.0.82 capture already in hand (no prompt marker exists in current Copilot renders — the TS comment claiming otherwise is stale); the fixture is recorded, labeled, and the recognition case joins the characterisation suite. Also record, as findings only: the box-drawing exclusion set divergence vs TS, and the OMP false-blank-region case where TS mis-recognizes and Rust is safer (TS-side bug, reported upward, NOT fixed here).
value.interface: Implements FROZEN v2 verbatim: composer_region(capture, cursor_x, cursor_y). PaneObserver public surface unchanged; PendingClear semantics unchanged.
value.test_strategy: Characterisation FIRST: record real captures per layout live from panes on this machine (label harness + date), assert the extracted parser byte-equal to pre-move rendered_composer on every fixture — that is the extraction pin. ONE red-first witness: Unrecognized defers (ac-1115's new behaviour, provable red because today the fresh path does not exist and the tick path collapses to None/record_unknown — witness it at the composer_region level: a garbage capture must yield Unrecognized, not Recognized(empty)). PendingClear: port/keep its existing tests and add the redraw-race case if uncovered. TS pane-signals.test.ts region cases (:69-144) as cross-check list only.
value.note: If a layout cannot be recorded live, spawn a seat of that harness, record, close it — an invented fixture is the green-that-lies shape plan 110 just paid for.

Coders get their own worktrees off s111/anti-step-on; the PM merges, coders never merge. ABSOLUTE PATHS in every packet. Per-worktree CARGO_TARGET_DIR — a shared target has already produced a false red on this fleet. Whoever creates a worktree owns reaping it.

value.composer: PM, on s111/anti-step-on, after both units merge.
value.steps: (1) Wire permits_injection_fresh into the three consumers: delivery first-attempt (crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs:223 region), queued-retry drain, pointer worker (crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs:217). Tick-cadence permits_injection remains for cheap pre-checks; the FRESH verdict (composer-fresh, tap-from-tick, per O4) is the one that authorises an actual injection. (2) Regression-pin: paneless never gated; existing receipt-honesty decision table green untouched. (3) Daemon config gains interaction_idle_ms (default 60_000) beside pane_observer_interval_ms.
value.integration_proof: Two DeliveryService-level tests: (a) parked draft — non-blank composer, clock advanced past the window, delivery PROCEEDS (ac-1111 end to end); (b) stale-clear/fresh-typing race — observer state says clear, fresh capture says typing, delivery HELD and queued durably (ac-1114). Plus one live smoke on a real pane: type into a composer, pij send at it, watch it queue; clear the composer, watch it land.

value.when: after composition, before the PR into main
value.inputs: req-0004 verbatim + this impl-guide + full branch diff + the TS operator contract (typing-guard-contract.test.ts) as the checklist; priority order: (1) can a parked draft still block forever anywhere; (2) can pij's own echo ever clear a HUMAN hold; (3) is the fresh capture actually at the send boundary or still a cached tick; (4) does Unrecognized defer rather than release; (5) was every witness seen red before its green; (6) is PendingClear still load-bearing after the extraction (mutate it out — the suite must go red); (7) is there exactly ONE parser on the tree, or did a second one get minted beside the extraction; (8) hunt for any veto path that can outlive interaction_idle_ms without a fresh observation — including future-proofing: does a NEW veto source added later inherit the bound or bypass it.
value.model_override: cross-model from the coder's family — coder is gpt-5.6-sol on omp, so the reviewer must NOT be a gpt-5.6 variant; claude or gemini class, chosen from pij models at dispatch time. The reviewer re-derives verdicts by execution, never by reading.

value.text: Over-hold regression (the TS 72b5dd61 emergency): retired by ac-1111 witnessed RED on the pre-fix tree, plus the idle window being config not constant.
Echo certification too loose eats a human's paste of similar text: retired by the exact whitespace-collapsed match rule + the paste test in u-gate.
Invented layout fixtures pass parsing that live captures fail: retired by the recorded-fixture rule in u-observer (record live, label provenance).

Fresh capture races the human's first keystroke (clear at capture, typing at inject): bounded, not eliminated — the window shrinks from observer-interval to capture-to-inject; note it in the findings doc, do not pretend it is zero.
Extraction mints a second parser instead of moving the one that exists — retired by review priority (7) and the byte-equal characterisation pin.
PendingClear silently deleted (no AC goes red) — retired by name-protection in u-observer, the redraw-race test, and review priority (6) mutating it out.

Unbounded veto via unrecognizability (found at wave 1): deferral with no expiry is the 72b5dd61 over-hold in a new costume. Retired by ac-1117's universal bound, witnessed red-first, plus the live-fixture Copilot recognition.
